title: A person's page shows its lists a page at a time
description: The tabs on a person's page in Analytics printed every row in one long scroll, and Activity quietly stopped at the last 100 actions. Every list now pages, and nothing is cut off.
items: Activity: What they did, and Changes to their account, as two tabs
Requests: Filed, and Decided at Gate 1, as two tabs
Tasks and Timesheets page as well
